Done. Summary:

**Source page**: a minimal "Off-scale tokens" test page — a `<main id="main">` with a `<div id="buttons">` containing two anchor links styled as pill-shaped CTA buttons (`.cta-a` "Get started", `.cta-b` "See pricing"), each with slightly different, non-Tailwind-scale pixel values (padding 9px/17px vs 10px/18px, border-radius 33px vs 34px, margin-top 14px vs 15px, colors `#017a07` vs `#018008`).

**Componentization**: Nothing warranted extraction into a reusable component — this is a two-button fixture, not a page with repeating cards/nav/etc. I kept the original `#buttons`/`.cta-a`/`.cta-b` markup structure and IDs/classes verbatim, transcribing both link texts and hrefs exactly (`/start`, `/pricing`) rather than paraphrasing.

**Off-scale token handling**: Per the task's emphasis (and the page's own title), I moved every value that doesn't land on Tailwind's default scale into `tailwind.config.extend`: custom `spacing` keys (`9px`, `10px`, `14px`, `15px`, `17px`, `18px`) and `borderRadius` keys (`33px`, `34px`), plus named `colors` (`cta-a`, `cta-b`) for the two green shades. The one value that *does* sit on Tailwind's default 4px scale — the 12px flex gap — used the built-in `gap-3` utility instead of a custom token.

**No JS-driven or unrecreatable sections**: there were none — no carousels, lazy content, or off-page assets to hotlink.

**Screenshot comparison**: Captured `original.png` and `clone-round1.png` at 1280×900 via headless Chrome. Round 1 was pixel-close but the original browser's default underlined-link styling was visible under the white text, while Tailwind's preflight reset had stripped it in my clone. Added `underline` to both CTAs and re-captured as `clone-round2.png` — now the two match (position, pill shape/radius, padding, spacing, and green shades all align). All four PNGs plus `clone.html` are saved in the run directory.
